reports.title: Full Truck Alliance Co. Ltd. Announces Third Quarter 2026 Unaudited Financial Results

guidance.heading: Business Outlook
section: The Company expects its total net revenues to be between RMB3.19 billion and RMB3.29 billion for the fourth quarter of 2026, representing approximately flat to a 3.1% year-over-year increase. These forecasts are based on the Company’s current and preliminary view of the market and operational conditions, which are subject to change and cannot be predicted with reasonable accuracy as of the date hereof.
